projects.title: n8n workflow to sync Airtable leads into HubSpot
projects.description: We collect leads in Airtable from two web forms. I need an n8n workflow that sends each new lead to HubSpot as a contact, skips leads that already exist (match on email), and posts a short summary in our Slack sales channel. We self-host n8n on a VPS. Please include basic error alerts so we know when a sync fails. Tell me how you would handle duplicates.

projects.title: Move 6 Zapier zaps to n8n
projects.description: Our Zapier bill keeps growing. We want our 6 zaps (Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Trello) rebuilt in n8n cloud and documented so our office manager can follow them. The zaps are simple: new email with a label goes to a Sheet row, new Trello card posts to Slack, and similar.

projects.title: Small automation for Shopify order alerts
projects.description: Need a simple automation that sends a WhatsApp alert to me when a Shopify order above a set value comes in. Any tool is fine.

projects.title: Logo for a home bakery
projects.description: Looking for a warm, simple logo for my home bakery. Three concepts, two revisions.
